Definition: structure; by implication, a model, resemblance
BiblicalUsage: God shows Moses the pattern of the tabernacle on the mountain, and says, see that thou make them after the pattern. David gives Solomon the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, for the house of the Lord. And Moses warns Israel not to make any graven image, the similitude of any figure. The word is pattern, model, form: the heavenly original, and the carved copy that must never be worshipped.
TheologicalSignificance: The pattern is the Bible's argument for a heaven we cannot see, I hold. I believe God showed Moses the real thing so the tent would be true, and warned Israel not to carve a pattern of their own and bow to it. The true pattern comes down from God; the false one is made by hands.
